name: Night desk dossier
description: Near-black desk at night. Real evidence sits on it as cream paper: source cards quoting the actual post, article, README or benchmark table with the key phrase marked in yellow highlighter, spec sheets with dotted leaders, and a small rounded mono chip under each naming its source. Real things (devices, chips, products, people, places) are flat SVG drawings with a true silhouette and a few telling details, never photos. Abstract quantities are physical: memory is a container on a shelf with a scale beside it, prices are yellow tags hanging from a pin on a string, verdicts are red rubber stamps, comparisons are bars on one baseline. Each beat has ONE hero: a huge yellow (or red) Space Grotesk number or word, 140-220 px, with a small uppercase mono unit under it. Everything else is small and quiet: uppercase JetBrains Mono labels in grey, thin 3 px lines, 6 px corners, soft drop shadows under paper. Composition uses the whole frame and is asymmetric: the main subject on one side, the hero number across from it, the evidence card in a free corner; the stage stays up and builds while the camera pans to what is new. Motion is crisp: things snap in with a short overshoot, tags swing to rest, stamps slam, highlighter sweeps left to right, gauges fill.
rejected: Bright sticker collage with photo cut-outs: loud and fun, but photos are off for this channel and a busy collage hides the one number each beat is about.

meanings.yellow: the number or phrase this beat is about; the better result
meanings.red: the cost, limit, failure or verdict against
meanings.blue: the thing being measured: memory, capacity, throughput
meanings.paper: real sources and documents: posts, papers, specs, tables
